sheets.admin.title: Google Sheets
sheets.admin.lede: Users can send form submissions to a Google Sheet and fill site data from a sheet. dropsite works as one Google service account: users share their spreadsheets with its address.
sheets.admin.unreadable: The stored key cannot be decrypted (restored without the key file?). Paste it again.
sheets.admin.key.hint: Paste the whole JSON file. It is checked with Google, stored encrypted and never shown again.
sheets.admin.howto.1: In Google Cloud Console create a project (or pick one) and enable the Google Sheets API.
sheets.admin.howto.2: In IAM & Admin → Service accounts create a service account; it needs no roles.
sheets.admin.howto.3: Open the account, Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON, and download the file.
sheets.admin.howto.4: Paste the file content here. Users will share spreadsheets with the account's address.
sheets.admin.saved: Google Sheets connected: share spreadsheets with {email}.
sheets.admin.cleared: The key was removed; Google Sheets features are off.
sheets.title: Google Sheet
sheets.lede: Keep this data in a Google Sheet: row 1 holds the field names, every other row becomes a document. Values follow the types of the schema.
sheets.moderated: A moderated collection cannot take its data from a Google Sheet: its documents are proposed by visitors.
sheets.off: Google Sheets is not connected on this server. Ask the administrator to add a Google service account key in Settings.
sheets.share: First share the spreadsheet with {email} (Viewer is enough), then paste the link to the sheet.
sheets.warn: The sheet is the source of the data: each synchronization replaces the documents of this collection with the sheet's rows. Edits made here or in the chat are overwritten.
sheets.url.hint: Open the sheet (tab) in the browser and copy the address; it ends with #gid=…
sheets.linked: The sheet is linked: {rows} row(s) on the site.
sheets.unlinked: The sheet is unlinked; the data stays as it is.
forms.add.sheets.hint: Share the spreadsheet with {email} as Editor. Every submission becomes a row; new fields get new columns.
forms.add.sheets.off: Google Sheets is not connected. Ask the administrator to add a Google service account key in Settings.
err.sheets_not_configured: Google Sheets is not connected on this server. Ask the administrator to add a Google service account key in Settings.
err.sheets_invalid_url: This is not a Google Sheets link. Open the sheet in the browser and copy the address.
err.sheets_access_denied: dropsite cannot open this spreadsheet. Press Share in Google Sheets, add {service_account_email} as Editor (for submissions) or Viewer (for site data), and check the link.
err.sheets_invalid: The Google Sheets settings were not saved: check the values.
err.sheets_unavailable: Google Sheets did not answer properly. Try again later.
audit.action.collection.sheet.link: Collection linked to a Google Sheet
audit.action.collection.sheet.unlink: Collection unlinked from a Google Sheet
audit.action.collection.sheet.sync: Collection synchronized from a Google Sheet
